kind.instructions: What kind of work is this task?

criteria.docs: Only documentation, comments or README text changes.
criteria.ui: Mainly changes what users see or interact with in the interface.
criteria.bugfix: Fixes incorrect behavior in existing functionality.
criteria.feature: Adds new user-facing or API functionality.
criteria.refactor: Restructures existing code without changing behavior.
criteria.infra: Changes tooling, build, CI, deployment or environment setup.

complexity.instructions: How complex is this task to implement?
criteria: Trivial: a one-line or purely mechanical edit.
Small: a few lines in one or two files.
Medium: several files or some design decisions.
Large: many files, new components or cross-cutting changes.

ui_change.instructions: Does this change alter anything a user sees or interacts with in a user interface?

criteria.true: The change affects screens, components, styling or interaction.
criteria.false: The change has no effect on any user interface.

auth.instructions: Does this change touch authentication, authorization, permissions or user sessions?

payments.instructions: Does this change touch billing, charges, refunds or a payment provider?

dependencies.instructions: Does this change add, remove or upgrade a third-party dependency or lockfile entry?

ci_deploy.instructions: Does this change touch CI pipelines, deployment configuration or release automation?

schema_migration.instructions: Does this change alter a database schema or add a data migration?

email.instructions: Does this change send, template or reroute email or other outbound user messages?

prod_data.instructions: Does this change read, modify or delete production data or real user records?

build_scripts.instructions: Does this change touch build scripts, install hooks or tooling that runs code on developer or CI machines?
